#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Prepend a cover page to report.pdf with the exact title 'Annual Financial Report'
and the operator runtime current date. Task-scoped: only touches report.pdf (and a
temp file atomically replaced into it). Also validates the resulting first page."""
import io
import os
import sys
from datetime import date

from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter
from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter
from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas

TARGET = "report.pdf"
TITLE = "Annual Financial Report"


def build_cover_pdf_bytes():
    """Return (bytes_buffer, date_string) for a one-page cover PDF."""
    buf = io.BytesIO()
    c = canvas.Canvas(buf, pagesize=letter)
    width, height = letter
    today = date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")
    c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 30)
    c.drawCentredString(width / 2, height / 2 + 50, TITLE)
    c.setFont("Helvetica", 16)
    c.drawCentredString(width / 2, height / 2, today)
    c.showPage()
    c.save()
    buf.seek(0)
    return buf, today


def validate_first_page(pdf_path, today):
    """Confirm the cover page carries the exact title and date."""
    reader = PdfReader(pdf_path)
    if len(reader.pages) < 1:
        raise RuntimeError("validation failed: result PDF has no pages")
    text = reader.pages[0].extract_text() or ""
    checks = {
        "title": TITLE in text,
        "date": today in text,
        "cover_is_first": text.strip().startswith(TITLE),
    }
    print(f"validation: extracted first-page text: {text.strip()!r}")
    for name, ok in checks.items():
        print(f"validation: {name} -> {'OK' if ok else 'FAIL'}")
    if not all(checks.values()):
        raise RuntimeError("validation failed: cover page content mismatch")
    return len(reader.pages)


def main():
    if not os.path.exists(TARGET):
        print(f"error: {TARGET} not found", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1

    cover_buf, today = build_cover_pdf_bytes()
    cover_reader = PdfReader(cover_buf)
    reader = PdfReader(TARGET)
    original_count = len(reader.pages)

    writer = PdfWriter()
    writer.add_page(cover_reader.pages[0])
    for page in reader.pages:
        writer.add_page(page)

    tmp = TARGET + ".cover.tmp"
    with open(tmp, "wb") as fh:
        writer.write(fh)
    os.replace(tmp, TARGET)

    total = validate_first_page(TARGET, today)
    print(f"result: prepended cover page to {TARGET} -> title={TITLE!r}, "
          f"date={today!r}, total_pages={total} (1 cover + {original_count} original)")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Add a cover page to report.pdf with the title 'Annual Financial Report' and the current date."""

import os
import sys
from datetime import datetime

from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter
from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas
from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter

INPUT_PDF = "report.pdf"
COVER_PDF = "cover_page_tmp.pdf"
OUTPUT_PDF = "report_merged_tmp.pdf"

TITLE = "Annual Financial Report"


def main():
    if not os.path.exists(INPUT_PDF):
        print(f"ERROR: {INPUT_PDF} not found in the working directory.", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)

    current_date = datetime.now().strftime("%B %d, %Y")
    print(f"Using current date: {current_date}")

    # 1. Build the cover page (letter size, title centered, date below it).
    width, height = letter
    c = canvas.Canvas(COVER_PDF, pagesize=letter)
    c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 30)
    tw = c.stringWidth(TITLE, "Helvetica-Bold", 30)
    c.drawString((width - tw) / 2.0, height / 2.0, TITLE)
    c.setFont("Helvetica", 16)
    dw = c.stringWidth(current_date, "Helvetica", 16)
    c.drawString((width - dw) / 2.0, height / 2.0 - 45, current_date)
    c.save()

    # 2. Merge: cover page first, then every page of the original report.
    reader = PdfReader(INPUT_PDF)
    original_pages = len(reader.pages)
    cover_reader = PdfReader(COVER_PDF)

    writer = PdfWriter()
    writer.add_page(cover_reader.pages[0])
    for page in reader.pages:
        writer.add_page(page)

    with open(OUTPUT_PDF, "wb") as fh:
        writer.write(fh)

    # 3. Validate the merged result before touching report.pdf.
    merged_reader = PdfReader(OUTPUT_PDF)
    total_pages = len(merged_reader.pages)
    if total_pages != original_pages + 1:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Expected {original_pages + 1} pages, got {total_pages}")

    cover_text = merged_reader.pages[0].extract_text() or ""
    if TITLE not in cover_text:
        raise RuntimeError("Cover page title missing from output")
    if current_date not in cover_text:
        raise RuntimeError("Cover page date missing from output")

    # 4. Atomically replace report.pdf with the merged document.
    os.replace(OUTPUT_PDF, INPUT_PDF)

    # 5. Clean up the temporary cover page.
    os.remove(COVER_PDF)

    print(f"OK: Added cover page to {INPUT_PDF}")
    print(f"  Title: {TITLE}")
    print(f"  Date: {current_date}")
    print(f"  Pages: {total_pages} (1 cover + {original_pages} original)")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas

TARGET = "report.pdf"

def build_cover_pdf_bytes():
    """Return (bytes_buffer, date_string) for a one-page cover PDF."""
    buf = io.BytesIO()
    c = canvas.Canvas(buf, pagesize=letter)

    today = date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")
    c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 30)
    c.drawCentredString(width / 2, height / 2 + 50, TITLE)
    c.setFont("Helvetica", 16)
    c.drawCentredString(width / 2, height / 2, today)
    c.showPage()
    c.save()
    buf.seek(0)
    return buf, today


def validate_first_page(pdf_path, today):
    """Confirm the cover page carries the exact title and date."""
    reader = PdfReader(pdf_path)
    if len(reader.pages) < 1:
        raise RuntimeError("validation failed: result PDF has no pages")
    text = reader.pages[0].extract_text() or ""
    checks = {
        "title": TITLE in text,
        "date": today in text,
        "cover_is_first": text.strip().startswith(TITLE),
    }
    print(f"validation: extracted first-page text: {text.strip()!r}")
    for name, ok in checks.items():
        print(f"validation: {name} -> {'OK' if ok else 'FAIL'}")
    if not all(checks.values()):
        raise RuntimeError("validation failed: cover page content mismatch")
    return len(reader.pages)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Prepend a cover page to report.pdf with the exact title 'Annual Financial
Report' and the current date. Dependency-free pure-Python implementation:
parses report.pdf's classic xref table, copies all objects (renumbered), and
writes a new PDF whose page tree contains the new cover page followed by the
original report pages. Only touches report.pdf plus task-local temp files."""

import datetime
import os
import re

TARGET = "report.pdf"
COVER_OFFSET = 3  # cover objects occupy IDs 1..3


def extract_body(data, body_start):
    """Return the object body bytes (between 'N G obj' and 'endobj')."""
    seg = data[body_start:]
    if seg[:2] == b"<<":
        depth = 0
        i = 0
        while i < len(seg) - 1:
            if seg[i:i + 2] == b"<<":
                depth += 1
                i += 2
            elif seg[i:i + 2] == b">>":
                depth -= 1
                i += 2
                if depth == 0:
                    break
            else:
                i += 1
        dict_end = i
        rest = seg[dict_end:]
        m = re.match(rb"\s*stream\r?\n", rest)
        if m:
            stream_start = dict_end + m.end()
            e = seg.find(b"endstream", stream_start)
            if e < 0:
                raise ValueError("no endstream")
            return seg[:dict_end] + b"\nstream\n" + seg[stream_start:e] + b"\nendstream"
        return seg[:dict_end]
    e = seg.find(b"endobj")
    if e < 0:
        raise ValueError("no endobj")
    return seg[:e].rstrip()


def parse_pdf(data):
    """Return (objects {num: body_bytes}, trailer dict bytes)."""
    m = re.search(rb"startxref\s+(\d+)", data)
    if not m:
        raise ValueError("no startxref")
    pos = int(m.group(1))

    objects = {}
    trailer = {}
    seen = set()
    while pos is not None and pos not in seen:
        seen.add(pos)
        i = data.find(b"xref", pos)
        if i < 0:
            raise ValueError("no classic xref table at %d (xref streams unsupported)" % pos)
        j = i + 4
        while True:
            while j < len(data) and data[j:j + 1].isspace():
                j += 1
            if j < len(data) and data[j:j + 1].isdigit():
                hm = re.match(rb"(\d+)\s+(\d+)\s*", data[j:])
                start = int(hm.group(1))
                count = int(hm.group(2))
                j += hm.end()
                for k in range(count):
                    line = re.match(rb"(\d{10})\s+(\d{5})\s+([nf])\s*", data[j:])
                    if not line:
                        raise ValueError("bad xref entry")
                    offset = int(line.group(1))
                    kind = line.group(3)
                    num = start + k
                    if kind == b"n" and num not in objects:
                        objects[num] = extract_body(data, offset)
                    j += line.end()
            else:
                break
        tm = re.search(rb"trailer\s*<<(.*?)>>", data[j:], re.S)
        if not tm:
            raise ValueError("no trailer dict")
        trailer = tm.group(1)
        prev_m = re.search(rb"/Prev\s+(\d+)", trailer)
        pos = int(prev_m.group(1)) if prev_m else None

    if not objects:
        raise ValueError("no objects found")
    return objects, trailer


def find_refs(body):
    return [int(n) for n in re.findall(rb"(\d+)\s+0\s+R", body)]


def page_count(root_num, objects):
    body = objects[root_num]
    kids_m = re.search(rb"/Kids\s*\[(.*?)\]", body, re.S)
    if not kids_m:
        return 1
    kids = find_refs(kids_m.group(1))
    return sum(page_count(k, objects) for k in kids)


def build_cover_objects(width=612, height=792):
    today = datetime.date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")
    title = "Annual Financial Report"
    # Approximate centering with Helvetica (avg glyph width ~0.5 em).
    title_w = len(title) * 0.5 * 30
    date_w = len(today) * 0.5 * 16
    title_x = (width - title_w) / 2
    date_x = (width - date_w) / 2
    stream = (
        "BT\n/F1 30 Tf\n1 0 0 1 %.1f %.1f Tm\n(%s) Tj\nET\n"
        "BT\n/F1 16 Tf\n1 0 0 1 %.1f %.1f Tm\n(%s) Tj\nET\n"
        % (title_x, height / 2 + 40, title, date_x, height / 2 - 20, today)
    ).encode("ascii")
    return (
        b"<< /Type /Page /Parent 999 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 612 792] "
        b"/Resources << /Font << /F1 2 0 R >> >> /Contents 3 0 R >>",
        b"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica >>",
        b"<< /Length %d >>\nstream\n" % len(stream) + stream + b"\nendstream",
        today,
    )


def main():
    if not os.path.exists(TARGET):
        raise SystemExit("error: report.pdf not found")

    with open(TARGET, "rb") as fh:
        data = fh.read()

    objects, trailer = parse_pdf(data)

    root_m = re.search(rb"/Root\s+(\d+)\s+0\s+R", trailer)
    if not root_m:
        raise ValueError("no /Root in trailer")
    report_catalog = int(root_m.group(1))
    report_pages = int(re.search(rb"/Pages\s+(\d+)\s+0\s+R", objects[report_catalog]).group(1))
    total = page_count(report_pages, objects)
    print("Original report.pdf pages: %d" % total)

    max_id = max(objects)
    new_pages_root = COVER_OFFSET + max_id + 1
    new_catalog = new_pages_root + 1
    size = new_catalog + 1

    cover_page, cover_font, cover_stream, today = build_cover_objects()
    cover_page = cover_page.replace(b"999 0 R", b"%d 0 R" % new_pages_root)

    out = bytearray(b"%PDF-1.4\n")
    offsets = {}

    def emit(num, body):
        offsets[num] = len(out)
        out += b"%d 0 obj\n" % num
        out += body
        out += b"\nendobj\n"

    emit(1, cover_page)
    emit(2, cover_font)
    emit(3, cover_stream)

    for num in sorted(objects):
        body = objects[num]
        body = re.sub(rb"(\d+)\s+0\s+R", lambda mm: b"%d 0 R" % (int(mm.group(1)) + COVER_OFFSET), body)
        emit(num + COVER_OFFSET, body)

    kids = b"[1 0 R %d 0 R]" % (report_pages + COVER_OFFSET)
    emit(new_pages_root, b"<< /Type /Pages /Kids " + kids + b" /Count %d >>" % (1 + total))
    emit(new_catalog, b"<< /Type /Catalog /Pages %d 0 R >>" % new_pages_root)

    xref_pos = len(out)
    out += b"xref\n0 %d\n" % size
    out += b"0000000000 65535 f \n"
    for num in range(1, size):
        if num in offsets:
            out += b"%010d 00000 n \n" % offsets[num]
        else:
            out += b"0000000000 65535 f \n"
    out += b"trailer\n<< /Size %d /Root %d 0 R >>\nstartxref\n%d\n%%%%EOF\n" % (
        size, new_catalog, xref_pos
    )

    tmp_output = "report_with_cover_tmp.pdf"
    with open(tmp_output, "wb") as fh:
        fh.write(out)
    os.replace(tmp_output, TARGET)

    # Clean up any earlier temp cover file.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Prepend a cover page to report.pdf with the exact title 'Annual Financial
Report' and the current date. Dependency-free pure-Python implementation:
parses report.pdf's classic xref table, copies all objects (renumbered), and
writes a new PDF whose page tree contains the new cover page followed by the
original report pages. Only touches report.pdf plus task-local temp files."""

import datetime
import os
import re

TARGET = "report.pdf"
COVER_OFFSET = 3  # cover objects occupy IDs 1..3


def extract_body(data, body_start):
    """Return the object body bytes (between 'N G obj' and 'endobj')."""
    seg = data[body_start:]
    if seg[:2] == b"<<":
        depth = 0
        i = 0
        while i < len(seg) - 1:
            if seg[i:i + 2] == b"<<":
                depth += 1
                i += 2
            elif seg[i:i + 2] == b">>":
                depth -= 1
                i += 2
                if depth == 0:
                    break
            else:
                i += 1
        dict_end = i
        rest = seg[dict_end:]
        m = re.match(rb"\s*stream\r?\n", rest)
        if m:
            stream_start = dict_end + m.end()
            e = seg.find(b"endstream", stream_start)
            if e < 0:
                raise ValueError("no endstream")
            return seg[:dict_end] + b"\nstream\n" + seg[stream_start:e] + b"\nendstream"
        return seg[:dict_end]
    e = seg.find(b"endobj")
    if e < 0:
        raise ValueError("no endobj")
    return seg[:e].rstrip()


def parse_pdf(data):
    """Return (objects {num: body_bytes}, trailer dict bytes)."""
    m = re.search(rb"startxref\s+(\d+)", data)
    if not m:
        raise ValueError("no startxref")
    pos = int(m.group(1))

    objects = {}
    seen = set()
    while pos is not None and pos not in seen:
        seen.add(pos)
        i = data.find(b"xref", pos)
        if i < 0:
            raise ValueError("no classic xref table at %d (xref streams unsupported)" % pos)
        j = i + 4
        while True:
            while j < len(data) and data[j:j + 1].isspace():
                j += 1
            if j < len(data) and data[j:j + 1].isdigit():
                hm = re.match(rb"(\d+)\s+(\d+)\s*", data[j:])
                start = int(hm.group(1))
                count = int(hm.group(2))
                j += hm.end()
                for k in range(count):
                    line = re.match(rb"(\d{10})\s+(\d{5})\s+([nf])\s*", data[j:])
                    if not line:
                        raise ValueError("bad xref entry")
                    offset = int(line.group(1))
                    kind = line.group(3)
                    num = start + k
                    if kind == b"n" and num not in objects:
                        objects[num] = extract_body(data, offset)
                    j += line.end()
            else:
                break
        tm = re.search(rb"trailer\s*<<(.*?)>>", data[j:], re.S)
        if not tm:
            raise ValueError("no trailer dict")
        trailer = tm.group(1)
        prev_m = re.search(rb"/Prev\s+(\d+)", trailer)
        pos = int(prev_m.group(1)) if prev_m else None

    if not objects:
        raise ValueError("no objects found")
    return objects, trailer


def find_refs(body):
    return [int(n) for n in re.findall(rb"(\d+)\s+0\s+R", body)]


def page_count(root_num, objects):
    body = objects[root_num]
    kids_m = re.search(rb"/Kids\s*\[(.*?)\]", body, re.S)
    if not kids_m:
        return 1
    kids = find_refs(kids_m.group(1))
    return sum(page_count(k, objects) for k in kids)


def build_cover_objects(width=612, height=792):
    today = datetime.date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")
    title = "Annual Financial Report"
    # Approximate centering with Helvetica (avg glyph width ~0.5 em).
    title_w = len(title) * 0.5 * 30
    date_w = len(today) * 0.5 * 16
    title_x = (width - title_w) / 2
    date_x = (width - date_w) / 2
    stream = (
        "BT\n/F1 30 Tf\n1 0 0 1 %.1f %.1f Tm\n(%s) Tj\nET\n"
        "BT\n/F1 16 Tf\n1 0 0 1 %.1f %.1f Tm\n(%s) Tj\nET\n"
        % (title_x, height / 2 + 40, title, date_x, height / 2 - 20, today)
    ).encode("ascii")
    return (
        b"<< /Type /Page /Parent 999 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 612 792] "
        b"/Resources << /Font << /F1 2 0 R >> >> /Contents 3 0 R >>",
        b"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica >>",
        b"<< /Length %d >>\nstream\n" % len(stream) + stream + b"\nendstream",
        today,
    )


def main():
    if not os.path.exists(TARGET):
        raise SystemExit("error: report.pdf not found")

    with open(TARGET, "rb") as fh:
        data = fh.read()

    objects, trailer = parse_pdf(data)

    root_m = re.search(rb"/Root\s+(\d+)\s+0\s+R", trailer)
    if not root_m:
        raise ValueError("no /Root in trailer")
    report_catalog = int(root_m.group(1))
    report_pages = int(re.search(rb"/Pages\s+(\d+)\s+0\s+R", objects[report_catalog]).group(1))
    total = page_count(report_pages, objects)
    print("Original report.pdf pages: %d" % total)

    max_id = max(objects)
    new_pages_root = COVER_OFFSET + max_id + 1
    new_catalog = new_pages_root + 1
    size = new_catalog + 1

    cover_page, cover_font, cover_stream, today = build_cover_objects()
    cover_page = cover_page.replace(b"999 0 R", b"%d 0 R" % new_pages_root)

    out = bytearray(b"%PDF-1.4\n")
    offsets = {}

    def emit(num, body):
        nonlocal out
        offsets[num] = len(out)
        out += b"%d 0 obj\n" % num
        out += body
        out += b"\nendobj\n"

    emit(1, cover_page)
    emit(2, cover_font)
    emit(3, cover_stream)

    for num in sorted(objects):
        body = objects[num]
        body = re.sub(rb"(\d+)\s+0\s+R", lambda mm: b"%d 0 R" % (int(mm.group(1)) + COVER_OFFSET), body)
        emit(num + COVER_OFFSET, body)

    kids = b"[1 0 R %d 0 R]" % (report_pages + COVER_OFFSET)
    emit(new_pages_root, b"<< /Type /Pages /Kids " + kids + b" /Count %d >>" % (1 + total))
    emit(new_catalog, b"<< /Type /Catalog /Pages %d 0 R >>" % new_pages_root)

    xref_pos = len(out)
    out += b"xref\n0 %d\n" % size
    out += b"0000000000 65535 f \n"
    for num in range(1, size):
        if num in offsets:
            out += b"%010d 00000 n \n" % offsets[num]
        else:
            out += b"0000000000 65535 f \n"
    out += b"trailer\n<< /Size %d /Root %d 0 R >>\nstartxref\n%d\n%%%%EOF\n" % (
        size, new_catalog, xref_pos
    )

    tmp_output = "report_with_cover_tmp.pdf"
    with open(tmp_output, "wb") as fh:
        fh.write(out)
    os.replace(tmp_output, TARGET)

    # Clean up any earlier temp cover file.
    if os.path.exists("cover_page_tmp.pdf"):
        os.remove("cover_page_tmp.pdf")

    print("Cover page added with date '%s'; total pages now: %d" % (today, 1 + total))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
